features.quote:
Progress monitor
Stop after N no-progress test runs and force a diagnosis turn.

Patch churn guard
Warn or stop when same hunk is edited repeatedly.

Tool repetition limiter
Block identical commands after repeated no-new-information results.

Escalation mode
Convert impossible tasks into a structured issue report instead of continued coding.

features.justification_quote: Technical pressure is sufficient. Do not use shame, insults, threats, or personal manipulation.
